properties.name: The home page says what the links answer, and charts reflow2's own design adding up, counted at each release
properties.rationale:
Anthony, 2026-10-13: the site "makes everything easy to understand, but undersells why it is powerful and much more complex than reflow2 simply recording decisions like some simple database ... it is more than just record" (req:the-site-shows-why-linked-decisions-are-more-than-a-record).

The numbers are generated rather than typed, because dec:the-sites-setup-pages-are-hand-written-and-its-design-pages-stay-generated keeps a real design's numbers generated. They are counted from the copy committed at each release, so they move with the releases and cannot drift from a hand-typed figure. The 35,421 INCLUDES links at v0.83.5 are each release listing the files it ships. Counting them in would triple the apparent linking, so they are counted apart, and a test pins it. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: reflow2's home page now says the record is connected, not only kept. It lists the questions the links answer that a list of notes can't: a change's reach, needs nothing delivers, decisions resting on a failed result, gaps nobody asked about, and who decided and what they did not choose. A new "It adds up" section charts reflow2's own design week by week (124 records and 153 links on 2026-07-19; 7,206 records and 18,045 links at v0.83.5), with release manifests counted apart. The numbers are written by tools/site_counts.py from each release tag when pages.yml publishes the site, which now fetches every tag and also runs on each v* tag. CI runs tools/test_site_counts.py, and AGENTS.md lists it.
